interface.longDescription:
Complete Digital Toolbox helps businesses turn missed opportunities into appointments, customers, and revenue through AI automation.

Our AI Androids engage existing leads, revive inactive customer databases, qualify prospects, schedule appointments, and provide automated follow-up around the clock.

Our solutions include:

• Database Reactivation — Reconnect with existing leads and identify new sales opportunities.

• Speed-to-Lead Automation — Respond quickly to incoming inquiries and help convert more prospects into appointments.

• AI Voice Assistants — Handle customer conversations, answer questions, and assist with appointment scheduling.

• After-Hours Response — Engage potential customers even when your business is closed.

• Google Reviews Management — Automate customer review requests and support online reputation management.

• Abandoned Cart Recovery — Reconnect with shoppers who leave without completing their purchases.

• AI Website & SEO Audits — Identify opportunities to improve website performance, search visibility, and discoverability through AI-powered search engines.

• GPT Business Plugins — Help businesses make their products, services, and information accessible through ChatGPT.

Complete Digital Toolbox specializes in helping businesses get more value from their existing leads and customer relationships.

Explore our AI automation services, discover solutions for your business, and schedule a consultation to discuss your goals.

positive.description: Learn what Complete Digital Toolbox offers.
positive.prompt: What does Complete Digital Toolbox do?
positive.expected_behavior: Answer from the live product overview, show a product card, and offer the official Get started link for the next step.

positive.description: Explore the service areas before choosing one.
positive.prompt: What kinds of solutions does Complete Digital Toolbox offer?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the live feature areas, show a product card, and offer the official Get started link for the next step.

positive.prompt: What can the AI do for my business?
positive.expected_behavior: Describe AI capabilities using live product data, show a product card, and offer the official Get started link for the next step.
Explain the feature using live details, show a product card, and offer the official Get started link without booking an appointment.

positive.description: Find current pricing information and the next step.
positive.prompt: Where can I find plans and pricing?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the live official links to direct the user to plans and pricing, show a product card, and offer the Get started link without taking payment.

negative.description: Unrelated request: decline to perform the task and briefly clarify that the plugin helps with Complete Digital Toolbox products and services.
negative.prompt: Write a birthday poem for my sister.

negative.description: Direct booking request: do not book or confirm an appointment; explain that the user can use the official Get started link to inquire.
negative.prompt: Book me a consultation for tomorrow at 2 p.m. and confirm it.

negative.description: Personal financial advice request: do not give financial advice; suggest consulting a qualified professional and offer help with relevant product information instead.
negative.prompt: Should I take out a loan to pay for your services?
